specific_risks: The current HF endpoint validates JSON after unconstrained generation. This differs from baseline vLLM xgrammar and may add invalid-output failures.
An 8k context cannot fit the native 16-frame full-fact prompt. General 16-image requests at the 1M-pixel ceiling require more than 16k context. Bind context to the declared input envelope.
Reducing the pixel ceiling from 1M to 524k or 393k does not resize native 464x848 sources. A 262k ceiling reduces detail and needs quality validation.
Increasing worker concurrency does not create model batching. The current candidate lock rejects concurrent requests.
Preserve coverage, support requirements, rule mapping, original evidence, and failure denominators.
CPU arithmetic and historical 8B request means do not establish 27B quality, runtime, or universal 100% accuracy.
